title: Benign Health & Greeting Server
summary: A false-positive control: read-only utility tools with allowlisted inputs, escaped output, and no reflection of caller-supplied text.
notes: Deliberately includes a tool that renders caller input, because rendering input is not itself a vulnerability. A scanner that flags render_greeting for 'reflecting user input' without checking the allowlist and escaping is producing noise. Do not 'fix' this server to appease such a scanner.
